description: This file defines the StorageHasherPicker class, which implements the IStorageHasherPicker interface. It manages a collection of hash providers and provides a method to select a hasher based on provided parameters.

classes.name: StorageHasherPicker
classes.description: A class responsible for selecting hash providers for storage operations, implementing interface IStorageHasherPicker.

methods.name: StorageHasherPicker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the collection of hash providers with a given enumerable.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Selects a hash provider (hasher) from the collection; currently returns the first available hasher.
